title: Monster
description: A creature/enemy. Each monster has exactly one element (Wuxing five-phase) that governs how phased effects interact with it via data/wuxing. Its attacks and innate abilities are drawn from the shared effect registry through schema.json#/definitions/appliedEffect, exactly like spells and consumables. Certain monsters can also drop spirit cores (see coreDrop).

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

phase.description: The monster's element. Required — every monster has exactly one. Determines elemental affinity: incoming phased effects resolve against it through the generating/overcoming/weakening/insulting cycles in data/wuxing.

attributes.description: The eight attributes (1-10), keyed by ability id. Optional; engines derive missing values from level.

hitPoints.description: Authored baseline HP; engines may derive from END + level.

abilities.description: The monster's attacks and innate powers, drawn from the shared effect registry (data/effects). A monster typically wields effects of its own phase, but need not.

coreDrop.description: If present, this monster can drop a spirit core on death. Mundane creatures (bandits, zombies, etc.) must not have this field.

baseChance.description: Base drop chance (0.0–1.0). Final chance is increased by the killer’s Luck and the monster’s level.

minGrade.description: Lowest possible qualityGrade of a dropped core from this monster.

maxGrade.description: Highest possible qualityGrade of a dropped core from this monster.
